purpose: One place that states what each shipped or exported artefact contains, what must never cross into it, and which notices must travel with it. Checked by desktop/delivery/content-boundary-check.mjs against a real directory or archive.

client.name: Windows client install (win-unpacked)
contains: Craftmine World.exe and Electron runtime files
resources/git/** (pinned MinGit tree required by R1's managed Git)
resources/source/** (build manifest, user guide, corresponding source archive)

mustNotContain.reason: repository internals never ship
development dependencies are not part of the install
test evidence is not a product file
credentials and environment secrets
credential store must stay in the user profile, never in the package
credential store must never ship
credential store must never ship
browser cache and profile data are user data
user world data lives in the profile data directory
debug symbols and logs are not delivery files
R1's managed git configuration is per-install user state

share-package.name: Creation-share package (craftmine.package/1 ZIP)
contains: resources/<contentHash>/payload/** (scene, source, data, assets, licence files)

mustNotContain.reason: R4 export reports credentialsIncluded:false
R4 export reports sessionIncluded:false
world progress never travels in a share package
rebuildable build cache
share packages carry content, not repository internals
managed Git configuration is per-install state

portable-backup.name: Full portable backup (craftmine.portable-archive/1)
contains: domain.json (full snapshot of every registered craftmine_* table)

mustNotContain.reason: rebuildable build cache is excluded by portable.rs REBUILDABLE
rebuildable copies
managed Git configuration is per-install state
operational tables are excluded

portable-backup.warning: sessionRowsIncluded is true: the archive can contain text the user pasted into tasks. It is not a shareable, redacted diagnostic.

standalone-game.name: Standalone Windows game export (CP4 / CP-A17)

mustNotContain.reason: an exported game never carries credentials
the creation history stays in the client
the workbench client is not part of a standalone game

standalone-game.pendingReason: No export output layout exists in the R4/R5/R6 trees (DELIVERY_R4 marks CP4 not started). The boundary is declared here so the first real export can be checked against it; it must not be treated as implemented.
